Bihar ki rajniti men MLC chunav ke bad Prashant Kishor aur Tejashwi Yadav ke sath aane ki charcha tej ho gaee hai. Rohini Acharya ke sujhav se lekar vipakshi voton ke bantvare aur RJD-jan suraj ke siyasi samikran tak, janie is charcha ke pichhe ki 5 bari vajah. kya PK aur Tejashwi sath aakar bihar ki rajniti men naya samikran bana sakte hain?
acharya
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
